ASTRA ULTRA — FINITE CAMPAIGN RESULT
9 October 2026

The requested historic foundational breakthrough was not established. The strongest result is an explicit mathematical separation between observable time symmetry, complete positivity of every reflected observation table, and compatibility with any hidden equilibrium model. Its complete internal proof and exact construction are in MAIN_RESULT.txt. Historical novelty, external expert validation and formal proof verification remain unestablished.

PRINCIPAL THEOREM

A rational irreducible ten-state stationary continuous-time Markov chain, observed through six deterministic letters, has a time-reversal-invariant observed law and a common ten-atom nonnegative factorization of every finite past/future reflection kernel. Nevertheless a bounded rational statistic of seven observations separates it from every stationary reversible hidden Markov realization under the stated conditional-feature interface. This excludes even finite-dimensional-distribution approximation by equilibrium models with unbounded hidden dimension and rates.

The mechanism is a failure of dynamic compatibility. Positive marker probabilities force a common static feature distribution onto the vertices of a cyclic pentagon and five markers. A saturated circle moment fixes its support. A monotone field has negative pairing with the required drift, contradicting every symmetric hidden transition coupling. The closure proof passes to couplings at a fixed lag without bounding or differentiating approximating generators. A separate constructive inequality makes the obstruction observable with finite temporal resolution.

The witness also proves that every compatible finite stationary all-even hidden CTMC has entropy production sigma > 6e-44 nats per model time unit. Time-reversal-even statistics admit a linear entropy transfer via path-affinity domination under additive reversibilization. The observed path-reversal relative entropy itself is zero.

The certificate requires time resolution 1e-12 and approximately 1.1e93 independent stationary windows for its conservative 95-percent Hoeffding guarantee. That is a sufficient cost for this explicit test, not a lower bound on all possible tests. No practical sensing capability or natural-science confirmation follows. ASTRA ULTRA — PORTABLE RESEARCH PACK — 9 OCTOBER 2026

1. Read MAIN_RESULT.txt for the strongest theorem, exact scope and full proof compilation.
2. Read CAMPAIGN_REPORT.txt for the final status of other candidates and evidence limits.
3. CLAIM_LEDGER.json governs claims in older exploration records.

Historic foundational discovery: NOT ESTABLISHED.
Principal result: complete internal analytic derivation plus exact rational certificates; external validation and priority unestablished.
No natural-system empirical confirmation and no practical capability claim.

Files retain their work/... paths for reproducibility. The full seven-context Sol proofs are under work/sol/. All reported Luna contexts, director reviews and negative results are under work/theory/, work/applied/ and work/natural/. Root reconstructions, provenance and final compilation inputs are under work/root/. Natural snapshot directories and theory recovered snapshots preserve prior own-research bytes; they are intentionally retained.

To reproduce the selected checks from this directory:
  python3 work/root/run_portable_checks_v3.py --root .

Python 3 with NumPy, SymPy and mpmath is needed for the entire selected suite. The main hidden-realization rational certificates, finite-witness coefficient check and observed-word evaluator need only the Python standard library:
  python3 work/sol/hidden_realization/verify_exact_certificate.py
  python3 -O work/sol/hidden_realization/verify_exact_certificate.py
  python3 work/sol/hidden_realization/fixed_lag_certificate_v1.py
  python3 work/sol/observable_separation/build_and_verify_witness_v2.py
  python3 work/sol/hidden_realization/observable_audit_v1.py
  python3 work/sol/observable_separation/evaluate_witness_v1.py --word 0 1 0 0 2 0 3

The evaluator reads only the fixed coefficient file and observed seven-letter words. Its --counts interface accepts headerless CSV rows of seven letters followed by an integer count. Alphabet: 0 for the internal aggregate, 1 through 5 for marker labels. Times: -t-h,-t,-h,0,h,t,t+h, t=1/1000,h=1/10^12. The supplied test word is a software-interface check, not acquired scientific data. No finite-sample claim follows from evaluating an arbitrary word.

The latest entropy bound is >6e-44, from observable_separation/v3.txt. Earlier Pinsker >2e-89 remains valid but is superseded. Worst-case acquisition cost remains about 1.1
